Class Anim

java.lang.Object
com.taskflow.ui.Anim
public final class Anim extends Object
A tiny animation engine built on Timer, so every animation runs safely on the Swing event thread. Animations are time based (not frame based) and therefore take the same time on slow and fast computers.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Ibrahim Masood

  • Method Details

    • run

      public static Timer run(int durationMs, DoubleUnaryOperator easing, DoubleConsumer step, Runnable done)
      Runs an animation.
      Parameters:
      durationMs - how long it lasts, in milliseconds
      easing - shapes the speed curve; maps 0..1 to 0..1
      step - called on every frame with the eased progress
      done - called once after the last frame; may be null
      Returns:
      the running timer, which can be stopped to cancel the animation

    • delay
